# uPlot

Small, fast chart library for time-series and XY data.

- **Source:** <https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot>
- **Version:** 1.6.31
- **Vendored:** 2026-05-15
- **License:** MIT (retained in the banner of `uPlot.iife.min.js`)

Used by the `GraphicalUi` chart renderer (`gui-charts.js`) for line, area, bar,
and scatter charts.

## Files

- `uPlot.iife.min.js` — minified IIFE build for inline `<script>` use.
- `uPlot.min.css` — required stylesheet for uPlot charts.

Both files are embedded into `graphicalui_assets.hpp`.
